title: Rigidity of Landau solution in the rotated self-similar class
summary: Landau solution is a special family of solutions to the stationary Navier Stokes equations, which is important for the study of stationary problems such as asymptotic behavior and regularity. In this paper we prove that the Landau solution is rigid in rotated self-similar class when rotation parameter $α$ sufficiently small or large. The arguments in the two parts rely on different approaches.
